title: Compatibility sentinel and migration harness for multi-version streaming & toolcall API
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: As we introduce new streaming semantics, function/tool-calling payload shapes, and richer structured-output schemas across API versions, customers see subtle regressions when clients or SDKs stay pinned to older behavior flags. We need an automated, low-friction way to detect behavior-incompatible changes early, provide per-tenant migration guidance, and enable staged rollouts with automatic fallback.

Goal: Build a compatibility 'sentinel' layer plus a migration harness that: (1) runs automated backward-compat tests (wire-level + schema diffs) on every model/build; (2) exposes per-tenant gating using behavior flags; (3) records replayable traces for failing requests; (4) surfaces actionable migration guidance for SDKs and customers; and (5) integrates with Console rollouts and runtime fallbacks.

Scope: This ticket covers the engineering work for the sentinel service and harness: prototype probes for streaming boundary semantics, function-call schema hashing, structured-output strict/lenient comparators, tenant-scoped behavior flags enforcement, replay capture format, and CI jobs that execute compatibility suites against historical corpora and synthetic edge cases. Does NOT include the full Console UX (tracked separately) but will emit the telemetry hooks Console needs.
acceptance_criteria: A sentinel microservice accepts a compatibility test matrix and emits pass/fail with deterministic failure categories (ordering, truncation, schema-mismatch, latency-violation).
CI integration: for every runtime PR, the compatibility suite runs and posts results as a GitHub check with links to failing traces.
Per-tenant behavior flags can be toggled in a test harness (not yet Console) to replicate canary/opt-in flows; toggles are audited in request logs.
Replay format stored in S3/GCS includes request bytes, model response, kernel metadata, and deterministic seed for deterministic decoding; replayer can re-run at least 90% of failing cases locally.

Migration guidance generator produces a one-page diff for structured-output and function-call schema changes with suggested client migration steps and recommended guardrails (lenient parsing, fallback route).
tasks: Design sentinel API and result taxonomy (ordering, truncation, schema, behavioral toggles)
Instrument runtime to emit wire-captures and kernel metadata for a sampled subset of requests
Implement schema-hashing for function/tool-call signatures and structured-output shapes
Build replay harness that can re-run captured traces deterministically against new runtime builds
Add CI job that runs compatibility suite and blocks merge on regressions flagged as P0
Create migration guidance generator for structured output and function-call changes (text + examples)
Integrate sentinel events with Console telemetry endpoints (events with links to traces)
Add e2e regression tests for streaming boundary cases (partial tokens, mid-chunk tool call, resume after preempt)
Document behavior-flag contract and recommended phasing strategy for PM and SDK teams
comments: 2026-03-03 - Asha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes: agreed sentinel should be independent service to avoid coupling runtime deploy cadence. Marco volunteered to own API design.

2026-03-04 - Marco Rivera: Spike complete: captured sample traces show 3 orthogonal failure modes—schema drift, streaming chunk boundary mismatch, and function-call arg reordering under quantized kernels. Prototype replayer can reproduce schema drift 87% of the time.
2026-03-06 - Product (Leila Morgan): PM feedback — add explicit migration text for hosted customers and a template email for Dedicated customers on longer upgrade windows.

2026-03-08 - Eng Review (Priya Shah): Implementation note: prefer adding a compact protobuf envelope for replay artifacts (smaller than raw JSON) and include kernel selection metadata to help explain nondeterminism introduced by new kernels.

2026-03-10 - Marco Rivera: Initial PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pulls/1428 — CI job wired but gated behind a feature flag 'compat-sentinel-ci'. Needs infra to provision a short-lived bucket for artifacts.

2026-03-12 - Asha Patel: Security review ask: ensure replay artifacts are scrubbed of PII; working with Security to map required redaction rules. Added security_review_required=false for now because redaction is tracked as a separate task.
